计费回调每次重试必须携带同一事件 ID，接收端按事件 ID 去重，绝不重复入账。

# Webhook 策略

## 重试超时

陈默在 v2.1 确定单次 webhook 重试超时为 5 秒，原因是避免慢响应拖垮工作线程。从 v2.4 起，因上游 p99 延迟升高，经平台负责人林岚批准，单次 webhook 重试超时提高至 10 秒。指数退避上限保持 60 秒。

## 幂等边界

计费回调每次重试必须携带同一事件 ID，接收端按事件 ID 去重，绝不重复入账。

limits: Tested on one host and model (Codex CLI 0.171.0, gpt-6.1-terra, medium reasoning); does not retest DeepSeek Flash on DSH where the 5.15 243k spiral was observed.
Small synthetic sample (1-2 repeats per case); single-turn API round-trip variance (+/-15-18k cached input per extra turn) exceeds the ~8-11k savings from skipping preflight and context-spaces.
Coordinator reviewed saved files, transcripts, kernel inotify opens, and cold-reader answers directly without a separate model judge.
